section_summary: This section contains reports and reference materials produced by the Agriculture Division of SCAP's Natural Resources Section in September 1949 detailing Japanese agricultural programs under the Allied Occupation. It includes individual subject monographs on land reclamation and improvement, soil survey methods, compulsory staple food collection, crop reporting statistics, agricultural research reorganization, rural extension services, land reform accomplishments, agricultural cooperatives, and crop and livestock insurance. The section concludes with the title page, introduction, table of contents, and comprehensive summary of the compiled publication 'Japanese Agriculture: Programs Under the Occupation,' which was forwarded to the Department of State by the U.S. Political Adviser for Japan in November 1949.

subfiles.about: This report reviews Japan's land reclamation and improvement programs, detailing legal reforms, financial subsidies, and Occupation technical guidance.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Reviews the administration and progress of Japanese land reclamation and improvement, detailing postwar legislative reforms, central subsidies, and SCAP engineering guidance.
subfiles.title: Land Reclamation and Improvement in Japan

subfiles.about: This report outlines historical Japanese soil mapping methods and describes the reconnaissance soil survey initiated by SCAP based on soil profile morphology.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Outlines Japanese soil mapping history and describes SCAP's reconnaissance soil survey classifying soils into associations based on profile morphology.
subfiles.title: Soil Survey in Japan

subfiles.about: This report examines the compulsory staple food collection system in Japan, covering delivery quotas, parity pricing, incentive goods, administrative challenges, and delivery statistics.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This report reviews the wartime origins and postwar continuation of compulsory staple food collections in Japan, explaining delivery quota setting, sub-allocations, parity pricing, and incentive goods. It assesses administrative problems including crop production estimation, governmental decentralization, and political pressures. Statistical charts and delivery figures from 1942 to 1948 illustrate collection trends, concluding that rigid official collections remain necessary while Japan faces food deficits.
subfiles.title: Food Collection in Japan

subfiles.about: This report discusses the development and reorganization of Japan's crop reporting and agricultural statistics system under SCAP guidance.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Traces the history of Japanese crop statistics and details SCAP-directed reorganization establishing an independent bureau utilizing objective sampling techniques.
subfiles.title: Crop Reporting in Japan

subfiles.about: This report reviews the consolidation of agricultural experiment stations and the introduction of modern experimental design techniques in Japan.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
keywords: Law for Improvement and Promotion of Agriculture
subfiles.summary: Examines the consolidation of Japan's agricultural experiment stations under 1948 legislation and the introduction of randomized experimental design methods.
subfiles.title: Agricultural Research in Japan

subfiles.about: This report describes the establishment of a democratic agricultural extension and farm advisory service in Japan following the dissolution of the wartime Nogyokai.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Outlines the establishment of a democratic agricultural advisory extension service and rural youth clubs under 1948 legislation replacing wartime controls.
subfiles.title: Agricultural Extension in Japan

subfiles.about: This report details the objectives, legal framework, land commission administration, transfer statistics, and financing of the Japanese agrarian land reform program.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Reviews the land reform program transferring over four million acres to owner-cultivators through local commissions and establishing fair tenancy protections.
subfiles.title: Japanese Land Reform Program

subfiles.about: This report describes the dissolution of authoritarian wartime agricultural associations and the establishment of independent, farmer-controlled cooperatives.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Details the dissolution of totalitarian wartime Nogyokai associations and the organization of over 32,000 voluntary, farmer-controlled cooperatives under 1947 legislation.
subfiles.title: Agricultural Cooperative Program in Japan

subfiles.about: This report explains Japan's reorganized agricultural loss compensation system, including compulsory crop insurance, livestock insurance, and government subsidies.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Explains the subsidized agricultural insurance program enacted under the 1947 Compensation Against Agricultural Loss Law covering major crops and livestock.
subfiles.title: Crop and Livestock Insurance Program in Japan

subfiles.about: This publication contains an introductory review, table of contents, and comprehensive summary of Allied agricultural policies, production programs, and institutional reforms in Japan.
subfiles.from: Agriculture Division, Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This publication, enclosed with a diplomatic despatch from the U.S. Political Adviser in Tokyo, provides an introduction, table of contents, and comprehensive summary of Occupation agricultural policies in Japan. It evaluates staple food production trends, commercial fertilizer supplies, insect and disease controls, certified seed breeding, livestock numbers, and food storage facilities. The summary further details administrative accomplishments in land reclamation, soil classification, food collections, crop reporting, research reorganization, and agricultural extension services.
subfiles.title: Japanese Agriculture: Programs Under the Occupation
